tools.name: catalog.search
tools.description: Search shops that publish a signed Agent Card, plus shops listed from public data (provenance "unclaimed": search-only, no door). Each result gives the shop's DID, origin, Agent Card URL and the matching products, so an agent can go straight to that shop's Agent Entry with a signed request.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: catalog.search · Public sink: catalog.search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: catalog.search · Public sink: catalog.search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
